About George Returned to Our District Sign Up For Newsletter & Text Alerts Serving the Antelope Valley, Santa Clarita Valley, and San Fernando Valley Constituent Success Stories Testimonies from residents of California’s 27th District. Contact Me { I had an issue with the Veterans Administration. They cut off my medical supplies for in home medicine treatment and wanted me to travel 65 miles to West Los Angeles or 91 miles to Bakersfield 3 times a month. At this time in my life, I didn’t own an automobile and was relying on a relative to take me. I went through all the procedures to protest getting my supplies back. The V.A. had no response in a timely matter. I met Representative Whitesides at a veteran’s event and was given a contact in his office. His caseworker was very welcoming and understanding of my predicament and fixed the problem. I am now receiving my supplies due to her hard work and dedication. Paul C., Lancaster { I really appreciate Representative George Whitesides’ office assisting with navigating my case through the federal agency, IRS. The IRS owed me a substantial refund. I complied with all requests and my taxes were filed without errors. However, after 4 months of filing, I still had not had not received my refund. I reached out to Representative George Whitesides office, and was assigned Caseworker Simone Pierce, who was informative and attentive. After submitting required documents to support my case, he reached out the IRS. In 3 weeks, my refund was direct deposited with interest to my bank account. I must say, George Whitesides is for the people. Thank you! Katrina R., Santa Clarita { I had an issue with my Medicare and had been dealing with the Social Security Administration for many months trying to resolve the problem, but had no success. My insurance company was about to drop my coverage and my eye treatments would have been canceled, so I made a quick visit to Congressman Whitesides’ Office in Valencia to seek help. Issues | Representative George Whitesides Top Priorities $ Congress Congressman Whitesides believes public trust is earned through honesty and action. He is committed to bringing transparency to Washington, taking on corruption, and ensuring that his constituents’ needs are what guide every decision. $ Energy Congressman Whitesides is committed to creating cost-effective, clean energy policies that achieve American energy independence through innovation. He believes in harnessing the power of the private sector to drive clean energy solutions that lower costs, create jobs, and secure a more sustainable future for all. $ Economy Congressman Whitesides is a champion for working families, advocating for policies that lower costs while growing the job market. His experience creating hundreds of well-paid jobs in the Antelope Valley informs his policies to grow local businesses, and create educational and workforce opportunities for our district. $ Education Congressman Whitesides is working to ensure that every child has access to high-quality, affordable education regardless of their zip code or socioeconomic status. By investing in our students, our public education system, our community colleges, and our workforce development pipeline, we can ensure that every young person in our district has the opportunity to succeed. $ Health Congressman Whitesides is fighting to protect access to high-quality, affordable health care, support our local hospitals, and defend reproductive rights $ Veterans As a member of the House Armed Services Committee, Congressman George Whitesides is a proud advocate for our nation’s veterans. In Congress, he is committed to honoring their service by fighting to ensure they receive the support, care, and recognition they have rightfully earned. $ Wildfires Congressman Whitesides is deeply committed to safeguarding our communities from catastrophic wildfires and addressing the home fire insurance crisis. He advocates for wildfire prevention and response efforts, pushing for numerous policies to improve community resilience, cut through red tape, and give firefighters the tools they need to carry out their critical work.

Energy | Representative George Whitesides Congressman Whitesides recognizes the critical role the private sector plays in advancing cutting-edge technologies that can drive America toward energy independence. He views renewable, green energy as not just good for the planet, but as a vital component of the nation’s economic and technological future. That’s why he is committed to leveraging private-sector innovation to develop the next generation of cost-effective energy solutions right here in the United States. In Congress, he is actively working to lower energy costs for consumers and ensure that sustainable energy is affordable, practical, and accessible for all. Economy | Representative George Whitesides Congressman George Whitesides is committed to building a strong local economy by lowering the cost of basic needs like food, housing, gas, child care, and health care, while also supporting small businesses, creating high-quality jobs, and investing in infrastructure that boosts regional competitiveness. In Congress, he’s fighting for practical solutions to lower costs and ease the burden of inflation — including cutting taxes for homeowners, lowering the cost of energy bills, and protecting vital programs like Social Security and Medicaid. His priority is ensuring economic security for families in his district. Through business accelerator programs and smart development, he’ll work to attract new employers and expand opportunities across CA-27. Veterans | Representative George Whitesides Ensuring that veterans receive the benefits they’ve earned is one of Congressman George Whitesides’ top priorities. As a member of the House Armed Services Committee, he is committed to strengthening national security while supporting military installations, including those in California’s 27th District. Congressman Whitesides firmly believes that veterans deserve lasting recognition and respect for their service. As the Representative for CA-27, he proudly advocates for veterans and their families — working to expand access to benefits, promote employment opportunities, and ensure they are supported long after their service ends. Education | Representative George Whitesides As a father of two, Congressman George Whitesides understands the direct impact education has on our children’s future. He is proud to represent a district with over 40 schools across more than 12 school districts, including several institutions for higher learning like the College of the Canyons, and Antelope Valley College. Congressman Whitesides is working to ensure that every child has access to a high-quality, affordable education, because he believes our kids deserve a quality education regardless of their zip code. This includes the advancement of STEM programs through partnerships with local industries to foster career exploration and bridge the gap between classroom learning and industry needs. Education is an essential investment in the future of our district and opens doors to new opportunities for our children, which is why he is focused on supporting our schools and advocating for our, parents, teachers, and students alike.
